sloka: तस्मिन् तत् आश्रम पदे निहितः खड्ग उत्तमः ।स न्यास विधिना दत्तः पुण्ये तपसि तिष्ठतः ॥३-९-१८॥
transliteration: tasmin tat āśrama pade nihitaḥ khaḍga uttamaḥ ।sa nyāsa vidhinā dattaḥ puṇye tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ ॥3-9-18॥

translations.english: Once Indra, husband of Sachi, came to his hermitage in the guise of an attendant, sword in hand, in order to hinder his penance.
